verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party way to plug off-the-shelf assistants such as Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor into Letta's memory. The closest items are adjacent: shared memory works only between Letta agents, and the OpenAI-compatible API and ACP adapter let third-party clients drive a Letta agent rather than share memory with their own assistants. The only MCP server mentioned is community-built, and model-agnosticism (Letta agents running on Claude or GPT models) is a different capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect off-the-shelf assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) to the same memory so every tool I use shares what it knows about me
